qa_pairs.question: Which connector pins are identified as C4 (16 pins) and C5 (19 pins) and where are they located?
qa_pairs.answer: C4 (16 pins) and C5 (19 pins) are located under the cover on the printed circuit board at the rear of the instrument cluster.

qa_pairs.question: What color wire is associated with the low fuel warning indicator?
qa_pairs.answer: Yellow wire is associated with the low fuel warning indicator.

qa_pairs.question: At what fuel level does the fuel tank sender switch close?
qa_pairs.answer: The fuel tank sender switch closes when the tank contains less than 1.5 gallons.

qa_pairs.question: Which wire color combination is used for the .75 BR/YL connection?
What components are connected to ground point G200?
qa_pairs.answer: The oil temperature sensor is connected to ground point G200.

qa_pairs.question: What important note is provided about some vehicles at the bottom of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: Some vehicles may contain an additional splice (see ground distribution).
